name: dsh-business
description: Evidence-backed business strategy and commercialization from business model through pricing, profitability, elevator pitch and business plan.

interface.shortDescription: 从商业模式到定价、盈利和商业计划的证据驱动分析。
interface.longDescription: dsh-business connects customer value, revenue model, pricing architecture, channel economics, profitability, elevator pitches and business plans. It distinguishes facts, assumptions and missing evidence, and does not replace product delivery or growth execution.
defaultPrompt: 复盘这个商业模式，指出客户价值、收入来源、定价、渠道和成本之间的缺口。
检查各渠道的标价、成交价、成本、佣金和贡献毛利率，找出价格冲突和亏损渠道。
生成 30 秒、60 秒和 2 分钟的电梯 Pitch，只使用我提供的事实和证据。
把这些信息整理成一份区分事实、假设、缺口和下一步的商业计划。
